_comment: Deployment-specific routing for TheFlow. Kept out of categories.json, and out of git, because channel ids belong to one deployment while the taxonomy is shared. `routing` stays empty until the phase 2 channels exist (ROADMAP 5.1); until then every verdict resolves to `unsorted_destinations`, which is also the correct shadow-mode configuration. `health_destinations` is where TheFlow health alerts go (ROADMAP 13.10: failing enrichment, a stalled queue, silent ingest); without it they only reach the log.
